refreshNotes: Largely carryover from 2025: same 2.5L PHEV powertrain producing 266 hp combined, 14.4 kWh battery, 27 mi EPA electric range, 78 MPGe combined / 33 mpg combined when depleted. MSRP starts at approximately $54,365 (including destination). Lincoln markets 'refined braking and improved energy management' for 2026 but no major hardware changes. BlueCruise 1.3 standard. Sources: https://www.lincolnoffranklin.com/blog-what-plug-in-hybrid-features-are-in-the-2026-lincoln-corsair-and-aviator.htm , https://www.edmunds.com/lincoln/corsair/2026/plug-in-hybrid/
